g.text: Concept projection: small-world comparison depends on the null
Observed/null clustering-to-path ratio: 6.57 against ER; 0.70 against the bipartite null
ER: stored analysis's 100-graph mean. Bipartite: fixed episode and concept degrees; 40 trades per episode.
Dots are diagnostic runs, not a confidence interval. Mixing is not proved. Largest components: observed 499, null 500.
Projected edges: observed 5,935; bipartite mean 8,943. The bipartite null preserves incidence degrees, not projected density.
